learning_outcomes.text: Gains the ability to systematically identify hazards, anticipate potential risks in advance, and develop appropriate control and mitigation strategies.
Gains the ability to design work environments and equipment according to human physical and cognitive characteristics, improving productivity while preventing occupational accidents and diseases.
Gains the ability to identify required occupational safety inspections and documentation processes, ensuring legal compliance and effective workplace safety management.
Gains the ability to recognize fire risks, implement preventive measures, and apply appropriate response methods in emergency situations.
Gains the ability to identify occupational health and safety risks across various work areas and to plan and implement appropriate preventive and safety measures effectively.
Gains the ability to understand rights and obligations in working life and to evaluate and apply employer–employee relations within a legal framework.
